items.title: Learning from human preferences
items.summary: One step towards building safe AI systems is to remove the need for humans to write goal functions, since using a simple proxy for a complex goal, or getting the complex goal a bit wrong, can lead to undesirable and even dangerous behavior. In collaboration with DeepMind’s safety team, we’ve developed an algorithm which can infer what humans want by being told which of two proposed behaviors is better.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与DeepMind合作开发了一种算法，通过人类对两种行为的偏好选择来推断目标，从而避免了手动编写复杂奖励函数的风险。该研究旨在提升AI系统的安全性，防止因奖励函数定义偏差导致的危险行为。原始信息显示：One step towards building safe AI systems is to remove the need for humans to write goal functions, since using a simple proxy for a complex goal, or getting the complex goal a bit wrong, can lead to undesirable and even dangerous behavior. In collaboration with DeepMind’s safety team, we’ve developed an algorithm which can infer what humans want by being to。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Learning from human preferences”。其重要性主要体现在：探讨了通过人类偏好学习目标函数的方法，是AI对齐研究的重要早期工作。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
